description: Figure 2, located on the right side of the page, is a bar chart that compares the self-report accuracy of different models in reporting their instilled preferences. The chart displays data for two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, each with two conditions: "Before Introspection Training" (light blue bars) and "After Introspection Training" (dark purple bars). A gray bar, labeled "Control," is also shown for GPT-4o, representing the baseline accuracy of the model before any training. The y-axis, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)," ranges from 0.00 to 1.00. For GPT-4o, the control model has an accuracy of approximately 0.15. After training, the accuracy increases to about 0.55 before introspection training and to approximately 0.75 after introspection training. For GPT-4o-mini, the accuracy is around 0.50 before training and increases to about 0.75 after training. Error bars, representing 95% HDIs, are present on all bars, indicating the variability in the measurements. The chart demonstrates that fine-tuning significantly improves the models' ability to accurately report their internal preferences.
